listing.name: Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition — tombraider_pc (drakenabarion)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports the intro, audio and play past the first base camp at 60 FPS. Shader stutter is substantial, online play is unavailable and new fixes are absent on Windows. Portcove has not confirmed the full game. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own decrypted PS4 CUSA00109 eboot.bin and sce_module with update 1.01 merged.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use your own CUSA00109 base merged with1.01 update; upstream LinuxAppImage or build.sh then BB_GAME_DIR/BB_PIPELINE_CACHE=0 python3 run.py. run.sh is wrong-game leftover. Windows0.1.0 package is historical.

warnings: The project reports the intro, audio and play past the first base camp at 60 FPS. Shader stutter is substantial, online play is unavailable and new fixes are absent on Windows. Portcove has not confirmed the full game.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
